questions.question: What do the public records say about 42 Ponsonby Road?

quality.note: All figures are grounded and cited, hazard layers are kept separate with the area-level caveat and Flood Viewer/LIM reference, and ownership is correctly noted as non-public.

anthropic.answer:
The LINZ public records show that 42 Ponsonby Road, Grey Lynn holds a Freehold (Fee Simple) title — title number 932002, issued 26 February 2020, covering Lots 13, 14 and 15 of Section 1, Deposited Plan 242 {{c8}}, with a legal description spanning all three lots {{c6}}. The rating unit land area is recorded as 1,362 m² {{c7}}, while the title itself notes 1,341 m² for the combined lots {{c8}}. Ownership details are not part of the public record.

On the council hazard layers, the address falls outside the 1% annual-exceedance flood plain {{c1}}, outside coastal inundation zones at both present sea level and with one metre of sea-level rise {{c3}} {{c4}}, and is classed as Very Low Liquefaction Vulnerability {{c5}}. However, an overland flow path is recorded within twenty metres of the address {{c2}}.

Area-level model — not a property assessment. Check the council Flood Viewer and a LIM report for any specific property.
